speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI results are normal, which makes a primary neurological diagnosis like multiple sclerosis unlikely given your pulmonary findings. text: It is unusual to have a neurological diagnosis without MRI evidence; since your symptoms and imaging clearly point to COPD, I need to check your oxygen levels and complete blood count to rule out other systemic issues. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal strength test and lack of neurological symptoms on MRI make a primary neurodegenerative cause unlikely; your clinical picture is overwhelmingly consistent with COPD, likely exacerbated by your construction exposure and smoking.
